episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x1
episodes_data.description: Dexter falls victim to one of his own inventions and sends Dee Dee back in time to warn his past self about the consequences, but the past Dexter proves hard to convince.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x2
episodes_data.description: Monkey must defend the city from a giant underground lava monster, Magmanamus, who cannot sleep because of the noise created by its residents.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x3
episodes_data.description: When his mother falls ill, Dexter creates a robot to do her chores. Dee Dee gets hold of its remote control and wreaks havoc, forcing Dexter to create a second robot to counter Dee Dee's.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x4
episodes_data.description: Dexter is forced to play dodgeball by his P. E. teacher. Constantly failing, Dexter builds a robotic exoskeleton to defend himself.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x5
episodes_data.description: Intergalactic wrestling champion Rasslor challenges Earth's superheroes, including Monkey, with the planet's fate at stake.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x6
episodes_data.description: In need of an assistant to operate his latest invention, Dexter performs a brain transplant on Dee Dee to make her smart enough to fulfill the role. With her new brain, Dee Dee proves to be more intelligent than Dexter.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x7
episodes_data.description: Mandark Astronomanov, a new student at Dexter's school, seems to be superior to Dexter academically. Mandark forces Dexter to shut down his lab so that Mandark's lab can gain more power. However, with the help of Dee Dee, Dexter manages to destroy Mandark's lab.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x8
episodes_data.description: Monkey encounters Simion, an intelligent anthropomorphic chimpanzee who seeks vengeance on humans for turning him into his current state.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x9
episodes_data.description: Banned from watching a late-night movie due to his young age, Dexter uses his technology to artificially grow into adulthood, but Dee Dee tampers with his machine, causing Dexter to turn into an old man.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x10
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee and her friends, Lee Lee and Mee Mee, enter Dexter's lab and wreak havoc. Dexter clones himself to stop them, but the girls too make clones of themselves.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x11
episodes_data.description: Monkey's birthday party is interrupted by Barbequor an intergalactic villain who plans to eat the planets, and his sidekick, the Silver Spooner.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x12
episodes_data.description: Rerun of "Dexter's Laboratory", the first "What a Cartoon!" pilot.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x13
episodes_data.description: To clone a dinosaur with an incomplete DNA sequence, Dexter uses his dog's genetic code to fill in the gaps.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x14
episodes_data.description: While on a date with Agent Honeydew, Monkey gets hypnotized by the music of the Organ Grindor who commands him to rob Fort Knox.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x15
episodes_data.description: Due to overworking his brain, Dexter's mind shuts down, making him act idiotic.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x16
episodes_data.description: After Dee Dee steals his critical invention, Dexter ventures into her room to find it.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x17
episodes_data.description: Monkey encounters an alien hunter named Huntor and must fight him to save Agent Honeydew and Commander Chief.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x18
episodes_data.description: Rerun of the second "What a Cartoon!" pilot.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x19
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee enter tryouts to become Major Glory's sidekick. When Dee Dee wins, Dexter realizes that fancy costumes are not the only criterion to become a superhero.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x20
episodes_data.description: With only one television in their apartment, Major Glory, Krunk, and Valhallen disagree on what to watch: Major Glory's televised capture of the Disgruntled Postman, TV Puppet Pals, or the monster truck pull.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x21
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee's father buys a video game for them to play, but the game sucks Dexter inside when he plugs in the cartridge, and it is up to Dee Dee to bring him out.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x22
episodes_data.description: Dexter has a crush on his teenage babysitter Lisa. When he finds out that she has a boyfriend, he sabotages their relationship and accelerates his age by ten years in an attempt to win her heart.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x23
episodes_data.description: Valhallen loses his magic ax and starts turning into a nerd, forcing Major Glory and Krunk to enter his room to find it.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x24
episodes_data.description: When Dexter's nightmares become frequent and problematic, he invents a machine that allows him to have nice dreams, as long as Dee Dee can operate it properly while she is awake.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x25
episodes_data.description: Suspicious that Dee Dee has not entered his lab even once on a particular day, Dexter shrinks himself and enters her room to spy on her. He soon becomes an unwilling character in Dee Dee's doll story, but he believes the story to be real.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x26
episodes_data.description: While fighting Comrade Red and his gang, Krunk falls in love with his equivalent in their gang, She-Thing.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x27
episodes_data.description: Dexter's new device allows him to study for the next day's French test while sleeping. It malfunctions, causing a single phrase -omelette du fromage- to repeat throughout the night, causing Dexter to wake up the next morning speaking nothing else except "omelette du fromage".

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x28
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee teaches Dexter how to live life her way instead of being lonely and purely focused on science.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x29
episodes_data.description: Major Glory forces Krunk and Valhallen to tidy up their apartment for his Uncle Sam, who is coming over for a visit.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x30
episodes_data.description: To learn more about girls, Dexter camouflages himself and enters Dee Dee's room, where she is having a sleepover with her friends Lee Lee and Mee Mee. He gets caught by the girls, who force him to take part in their activities.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x31
episodes_data.description: To prevent himself from being taken away by aliens for experimentation, Dexter tricks Dee Dee into going instead, but he regrets his decision after realizing how much he cares for her.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x32
episodes_data.description: To fix their apartment's plumbing, Krunk and Valhallen go to the basement, where they meet Ratman, a diminutive vigilante raised by rats (a parody of Batman).

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x33
episodes_data.description: Dexter's lab is threatened with repossession unless he can repay his debt to NASA. When Dee Dee wins the same amount in a lottery, he decides to steal her money out of desperation.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x34
episodes_data.description: Major Glory, Krunk, and Valhallen try to rid their apartment of a bee.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x35
episodes_data.description: Following the destruction of his lab by Dexter and Dee Dee (in the episode Dexter's Rival), Mandark turns to magic to beat Dexter at the science fair.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x36
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee inflates Dexter's hydro-plasmatic suit and constantly floats in the air, prompting Dexter to bring her down.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x37
episodes_data.description: After fellow Justice Friend White Tiger helps Valhallen stop a super-villain, the latter invites him to spend the night in his apartment, forgetting that Major Glory is allergic to cats.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 1x38
episodes_data.description: Not interested in hearing Dee Dee's long-winded story, Dexter gives her a silencing formula to keep her quiet, but it instead turns her into a giant monster still bent on telling her story. When he realizes that nothing can make her quiet, he becomes a giant monster himself.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x1
episodes_data.description: After a fright from Dee Dee, Dexter lays down in the beard growing machine and tries to grow a beard like his hero, Action Hank. Unfortunately, everyone thinks he's a hero.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x2
episodes_data.description: Mandark doesn't know that his pet duck is really Quackor the Fowl, Monkey's rival. Quackor overhears Mandark talking in his sleep about destroying Dexter's lab and tries to do it, unaware that Monkey is Dexter's pet.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x3
episodes_data.description: Dexter prevents Dee Dee from destroying some ants. In order to teach her about ants, Dexter and Dee enter Dexter's ant farm. The ants think Dexter is a criminal and has him fight to the death with a stronger ant.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x4
episodes_data.description: Dexter switches his brain with a mouse, and must avoid his mother when she decides to exterminate him. A Parody of Tom and Jerry.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x5
episodes_data.description: At the Chubby Cheese pizza restaurant, Dexter wears a Chubby Cheese hat and tries to slow down the Whack The Weasel machine to win a stuffed Monkey doll before Dee Dee does.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x6
episodes_data.description: One of Dexter's robots becomes Dee Dee's servant when she removes a wrench that froze him up, but the robot is willing to destroy anyone who is mean to her or scolds her, including Dexter.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x7
episodes_data.description: When Dexter's friends tire of the complicated traps he sets up as Dungeon Master (he has their character's killed every time), they put Dee Dee in charge for a change of pace.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x8
episodes_data.description: Dexter's father gets challenged to an arm wrestling match against a local champion at a truck stop, when he causes the champion to lose for the first time, but refuses to do so even when he trashes the family car. He finally accepts the challenge when he slams the door in Mom's face. Dee Dee knows he'll get creamed, so Dexter builds him a robotic arm to help him win the match.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x9
episodes_data.description: Dexter uses radiation therapy so he can like vegetables, it actually causes him to only eat vegetables, also, the therapy has consequences if Dexter goes too long without them. He turns into a Parody of The Incredible Hulk without vegetables.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x10
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee's imaginary friend comes to life and annoys Dexter. Dexter ends up wishing him away, then he realizes he made a terrible mistake.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x11
episodes_data.description: Dexter oversleeps and still has to finish his homework along with getting ready for school and eating breakfast, so he creates a helmet that expands thirty seconds into thirty minutes, but realizes that slowing down time is more detrimental than helpful. When he gets everything done, the helmet shuts off. But Dee Dee blocks his door causing him to miss the bus. When Dexter asks Dee Dee why, she replies "Snow Day, school's canceled!". Dexter realizes he did all that rushing around for nothing!

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x12
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee Locks and the Ness Monster—Dexter's mother forces Dexter to read to Dee Dee when she's sick, but she makes up her own story after being bored by Dexter's story (which was actually a science article). The story is completely mixed up and makes no sense. Dexter ends up catching Dee Dee's illness.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x13
episodes_data.description: Dexter fuses Dee Dee with the family car by accident, causing mayhem. A Parody of Herbie the Love Bug.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x14
episodes_data.description: Dexter accidentally takes a library book without checking it out, so he and Dee Dee try to put it back without being caught.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x15
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee's new dance annoys Dexter to no end.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x16
episodes_data.description: Dexter calls upon the "shoe gnomes" to repair his boots, but can't rid himself of them afterwards. The only way to get rid of them, according to Dee Dee, is to kick them in the butt. Dexter gets rid of the last one with his boot, but it's damaged again.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x17
episodes_data.description: Dexter ends up in the "old part of the lab" where his earliest inventions, long since forgotten, are not too happy to see him. They are mad at him for saying they were his greatest inventions, then moved on to another great invention.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x18
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee label everything in the house. When their parents get home, they mistake Dexter for Dee Dee (he had a Dee Dee label on his forehead), but he already blamed Dee Dee for the chaos.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x19
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee compete against each other on a game show. Where Dexter can't seem to win.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x20
episodes_data.description: Dexter tries to inject himself into Dee Dee to find a cure to the common cold, but ends up inside his dog. He believes Dee Dee has been infected with a dog virus. He is then mistaken for the first human virus to infect a dog by the vet.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x21
episodes_data.description: When Dee Dee refuses to flush their gold fish down the toilet, the ghost of the fish haunts them.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x22
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee and Dexter win a free pass to Professor Hawk's magic factory after finding the golden diskette.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x23
episodes_data.description: Dad encourages Dexter to become the king of snow, as he was in his early days, until someone beated him.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x24
episodes_data.description: In an attempt to be popular with his ""friends"", Dexter makes his own Mayor Glory Action Figure.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x25
episodes_data.description: In a whole parody of ""Speed Racer"", Dexter and Mandark compete on a race.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x26
episodes_data.description: Dexter can't get into a roller coaster because he's too small so he makes himself taller.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x27
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee steals the nuclear atom that Dexter needs to make his invention work, but she doesn't know that it will explode if Dexter doesn't find it on time.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x28
episodes_data.description: Everybody except Dexter gets sick, so he makes himself a plastic bubble to get germ protection.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x29
episodes_data.description: It's not a great day for science when Dexter has bad luck due to the position of the stars.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x30
episodes_data.description: Mom makes Dexter go outside and ride a bike, thing that turns into a Dexter-Dee Dee chase.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x31
episodes_data.description: While at the beach, Dee Dee (who's wearing a mermaid swimsuit) gets captured by a maniac sailor so Dexter must rescue her.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x32
episodes_data.description: Dexter must go to the back of the school bus to retrieve his pencil, where another kid got lost years ago.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x33
episodes_data.description: Krunk stays awake all night watching The Puppet Pals Show Marathon, so his brain starts playing him tricks.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x34
episodes_data.description: Dexter is sent to summer camp, in a place far away from civilization.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x35
episodes_data.description: While the family is at the woods, Dexter goes searching for the Mighty Bigfoot, if Dee Dee doesn't find him first.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x36
episodes_data.description: Dexter must stop Dee Dee from showing some pictures (that she took earlier in Dexter's lab) to Mom.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x37
episodes_data.description: Dexter and two friends go to the Star Check Convention, but certain confusion might send them to a different one.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x38
episodes_data.description: To avoid the bath, Dexter decides to laminate himself.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x39
episodes_data.description: Dexter will do anything to make the ice cream vendor stop to get some ice cream.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x40
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee get their Action Hank and Pony Puff Secret Codes mixed up.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x41
episodes_data.description: Dexter newest creation gives Mom super powers.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x42
episodes_data.description: Dexter's robot takes over his lab.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x43
episodes_data.description: Dexter heals a turtle by giving him loads of modern, techno stuff.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x44
episodes_data.description: Dexter makes himself invisible to make sure Mom and Dad give him what he wants for his birthday, the Ultimate Mayor Glory Action Figure.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x45
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee go to South America in order to find the chupacabras, an animal that Dexter created.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x46
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee, who's not exactly good at singing, gets Dexter's help on getting a better voice, but not the voice Dexter was expecting.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x47
episodes_data.description: When Dexter's favorite show gets interrupted by an emergency, he searches all town trying to find it and solve so regular broadcast returns.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x48
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee go to the dumps to retrieve Dee Dee's lost teddy bear.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x49
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee get trapped with a Finger trap.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x50
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee must stop Dad from eating Mom's muffins.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x51
episodes_data.description: Dexter finds out he's ugly, so he transforms his face to look better for the school photo.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x52
episodes_data.description: Dexter combines himself with bubble gum to become more stretchable.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x53
episodes_data.description: Dexter is send to detention after a confusion during a test.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x54
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Dee Dee want to become older, but instead they make everyone else a baby.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x55
episodes_data.description: A new female villian named Peltra wants Monkey's Coat.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x56
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee, LeeLee and MeeMee become crimefighters, but of course they will not actually fight crime.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x57
episodes_data.description: Dad wants to show Dexter the joy of sports.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x58
episodes_data.description: Koosy tells Dee Dee that he is the king of the land of Koos, but when Dee Dee goes there...

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x59
episodes_data.description: Dee-Dee refuses any kind of help from Dexter on her science project, when Dee-Dee shows Dexter her show-and-tell product, he criticises it heavily and offers his own..contributions

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x60
episodes_data.description: Surprised of the results coffee causes on Mom and Dad, Dexter and Dee Dee decide to try it themselves.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x61
episodes_data.description: Dexter uses his science to turn Dee Dee into a horse.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x62
episodes_data.description: Dexter overloads the energy of the laboratory, so he makes numerous tries to reload it.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x63
episodes_data.description: After Dexter did something really bad at school, he gets her mother called, so to not ruin his reputation, he turns Dee Dee into Mom.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x64
episodes_data.description: After Dexter gets bitten by a clown, he turns into one every night.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x65
episodes_data.description: On his way home, Dexter gets followed by a labrador, when he teaches him to speak, the dog becomes even more annoying.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x66
episodes_data.description: A confusion at the supermarket makes Dexter go home with a different, yet extremely scientific, family; but who is home with his real family?

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x67
episodes_data.description: Dexter is afraid of taking a dive at the pool because Dad always pushes him.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x68
episodes_data.description: After Dexter eats a giant burrito he believes he's going to die, so he makes a list of everything he must do before that time comes. (Including, make Mom and Dad happy, do dishes, free Robots, make World Peace, end World's hunger, learn to dance, make Dee Dee happy, shut down the Main System... and tell Mom and Dad about the secret laboratory).

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x69
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Mandark must team up in order to save the Earth from a meteor rain.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x70
episodes_data.description: After an I.Q. test defines Dexter as ""average"", he decides to live an average life hanging out with an average boy of last name Smith.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x71
episodes_data.description: Dexter and Mandark mechanize the giant figures of Lincoln and Washington from the Mount Rushmore statues and wreak havoc with them.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x72
episodes_data.description: Dexter creates a small bug that eats all the scrap metal caused by Dee Dee's destruction.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x73
episodes_data.description: Dexter's untested formula causes all plants in the garden to become dangerous.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x74
episodes_data.description: After Dexter returns a bunny to a little girl with big round eyes, she starts following Dexter everywhere.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x75
episodes_data.description: After Dexter ""fires"" Dee Dee, he realizes that his lab needs chaos.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x76
episodes_data.description: Dexter travels to the past to meet the caveman that discovered fire.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x77
episodes_data.description: Dexter attempts to make numerous accidents to get super powers.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x78
episodes_data.description: Dexter goes to Mars to find alien life forms.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x79
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee and the Ninja Clan battle for who delivers the newspapers in the neighborhood.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x80
episodes_data.description: After Dexter and Dee Dee destroy Dad's bowling trophy, they are sent to each other's room.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x81
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee builds a treehouse in the garden and Dexter can't stop wondering what's up there.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x82
episodes_data.description: Dexter worked all night on his inventions so all he wants is some sleep, but Dee Dee will make sure that that doesn't happen.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x83
episodes_data.description: Dexter and his friends Lucky and Pierre(¿?) are victims of a bully that hates kids with funny accents.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x84
episodes_data.description: Numerous factors like getting up early, being the first ones there, fishing clothes and other accesories, will not allow Dexter and his Dad to go on a fishing trip.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x85
episodes_data.description: Constant interruptions by Dexter, Dee Dee and Mom will not let Dad watch his golf game.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x86
episodes_data.description: After Dexter breaks his glasses, he starts a new fashion at school.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x87
episodes_data.description: Dexter meets a bum at an appliance store with a strange device on his head.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x88
episodes_data.description: Dexter goes to the appliance store to buy a lightbulb for his lab.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x89
episodes_data.description: Dexter takes piano classes from a man that looks a lot like Paul Williams.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x90
episodes_data.description: When an electricist comes to repair the house, Dexter discovers that if he repairs the lab it will function perfectly.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x91
episodes_data.description: Dexter creates a belt that can have its wearer do everything backwards,only to get in trouble when Dee Dee manages to get control of the time directional switch.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x92
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee keeps getting into Dexter's lab even though Dexter keeps throwing her out.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x93
episodes_data.description: Mandark tries to impress Dee Dee by getting into a surfing contest.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x94
episodes_data.description: Dexter makes Dee Dee a robot for herself, at the same time a volcano is going to burst on an island in the middle of the ocean.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x95
episodes_data.description: Dexter must save his family after they get possesed by aliens.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x96
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee must save Dexter who is a slave in a distant galaxy.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x97
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee and Lalavava (Mandark's sister), compete on a ballet contest.

episodes_data.title: Dexter’s Laboratory 2x98
